column1: # Everyday tickets (ADR-052, Phase 1, 2026-11-21): short, plain-language reports as employees actually type them.
# expected = the category the ticket should get, or TRIAGE when it is not an IT incident or too vague to route.
# CATEGORY|TRIAGE accepts that category or any ticket that ends in triage (a mixed-signal ticket a human should look at).
# Success for a labelled category is measured by team: the ticket is auto-routed to the team that handles the expected
# category (the team is decided by the classified category, ADR-036; e.g. SOFTWARE and APPLICATION share a team).
# "live 2026-11-21" rows were raised through the employee API of the running application on 2026-11-21 (25 tickets,
# 8 of them stayed unassigned in triage; E37 was refused there for its 4-character title "Help"); "control" rows were written for this file. Labels were written from the text,
# not from what the classifier answers, so a row may fail on purpose until the fix phases land.
